how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-unknown-19.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:91860:obj:0: Investigate Fenris Isle to the east and learn the fate of the ⟦E1⟧ traveling party.
rows.quest:91860:details:0: Out on patrol last night I spotted a group of gnolls dumping a very large body onto a pyre on the shores of Fenris Isle. I didn't see an elf or any smaller corpses, but I'd say this doesn't bode well for them.
rows.quest:91860:details:1: If you are brave or stupid you are welcome to charge into Fenris Isle to learn more, but if you ask me, its a lot of work to find some snooty elf that's probably long dead.
rows.quest:91860:details:2: I know you paladins love swearing oaths and taking on lost causes, but this one isn't worth it. Trust me.
rows.quest:91920:obj:0: Gather 3 murloc eyes and bring them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
rows.quest:91920:details:0: I wouldn't dare to question the effectiveness of Apothecary Renferrel's formulae, however I would be lying if I said that the potion made any noticeable difference.
rows.quest:91920:details:1: Along the shore of Lake Lordamere are a ⟦E2⟧ of murlocs, and of note, murlocs have eyes. I suspect the apothecary's willingness to try new things is suppressed by his recent obsession with hearts. Bring him a few.
rows.quest:91920:details:2: If my choice is to inevitably die a second death or have Renferrel kill me for questioning his methods, I choose the latter.
rows.quest:91921:obj:0: Bring Quinn's potion to Quinn Yorick at the Ivar Patch, north of the Sepulcher.
rows.quest:91921:details:0: Here is the new potion to aid in Quinn's recovery, made with love extracted from six whole hearts.
rows.quest:91921:details:1: Now, please excuse me before your presence necessitates more paperwork.
rows.quest:92109:obj:0: Bring 5 Empty Vials, 5 Silverleaf, and 5 Peacebloom to the young, aspiring alchemist inside the barn of Moonbrook in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:92109:details:0: Erm... 'Ello, . I'm not supposed to talk to strangers, but... Hey, what are those shiny bottles sticking out of your backpack for? Are you an alchemist? That's so cool!
rows.quest:92109:details:1: When I grow up, I want to be an alchemist too. Daddy won't let me play with any of his herbs; too dangerous, he says.
rows.quest:92109:details:2: Well, I want to start learning now. Could you maybe get some supplies for me, pretty please?
rows.quest:92110:obj:0: Gather 3 Murloc Eyes for the young, aspiring alchemist inside the barn of Moonbrook in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:92110:details:0: Wow, my very first potion! Did you know that mixing those two herbs together would change the potion to a bright red color when you first started?
rows.quest:92110:details:1: That was fun, but mixing a few flowers doesn't seem like the kind of alchemy Daddy does. He uses other ingredients too.
rows.quest:92110:details:2: I don't know what else to use, so let's try the first thing that comes to mind! Let's see... maybe murloc eyes? That sounds so gross, but I bet something will happen.
rows.quest:92124:obj:0: Speak to Daniel, Brother Paxton's assistant in the library.
rows.quest:92124:details:0: We need to take stock of how many books are missing!
rows.quest:92124:details:1: Go talk to my useless assistant, Daniel. He can do a quick inventory and let us know how serious the problem is.
rows.quest:92124:details:2: He's obsessed with the various trade professions in ⟦E4⟧. The boy keeps focusing on those instead of his important work helping me.
rows.quest:92124:details:3: Don't let him prattle on about tradeskills, and find out what's happened to my books!
rows.quest:92401:obj:0: Investigate the disappearance of Edward Heartweaver in the Ruins of Lordaeron.
rows.quest:92401:obj:1: *Investigate the disappearance of Edward Heartweaver in the Ruins of Lordaeron.
rows.quest:92401:details:1: He has not returned from his weekly journey to the graveyard in the Lordaeron ruins. Our son was lost when ⟦E5⟧ razed the city, and my dear Edward is still filled with guilt and sorrow that we never found his body. I've tried to warn him against searching those overrun ruins, but he refuses to give up. I try not worry, but it's been days.
rows.quest:92401:details:2: There are things there I cannot contend with but if you are willing, I need to know the fate of my husband.
rows.quest:92415:obj:0: Bring the Blood-Stained Letter to Orphan Matron Nightingale in ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:92421:title: Light's Justice
rows.quest:92421:obj:0: Collect 25 Intact Limbs within The  for Morbin Lightbane in the ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:92421:details:0: As a paladin of the ⟦E8⟧, it is my duty to exact the will of our Dark Lady while tending to our people's needs. We are fortunate with an opportunity to accomplish both.
rows.quest:92421:details:1: Above the ⟦E7⟧, the scourge still roam unchecked in great numbers. Our forces dwindle trying to reclaim our land, and decaying flesh cannot be reknit. Not without replacements.
rows.quest:92421:details:2: Would that our glorious captain Garek Bandarion still be with us, I know what he would wish. To finish what he started and heal our kin. For Lordaeron!
rows.quest:92421:completion:0: Let those who fall from the Banshee Queen's grace meet our justice!
rows.quest:92421:completion:1: With these parts, our brothers and sisters have hope to see another day. You do Captain Bandarion proud.
rows.quest:92422:title: The ⟦E9⟧ of Rath'mael
rows.quest:92422:obj:0: Kill Rath'mael in the  for Deathguard Kristof in ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:92422:details:0: Reports have come in from the Lordamere Overlook deep within the Ruins of Lordaeron. An unholy fog has taken over the streets and graveyard, affording the scourge up there some measure of stealth.
rows.quest:92422:details:1: Our scouts indicate they're being conjured by a new power within their ranks, a necromancer known as Rath'mael. We do not have the luxury of waiting this one out, ⟦1⟧.
rows.quest:92422:details:2: If you have allies, summon them and their aid to the ⟦E8⟧. Drive this creature out of our lands.
rows.quest:92422:completion:0: While I have no doubt something of his kind will be replaced, we can only hope their ranks thin in the meantime.
rows.quest:92432:obj:0: Report to the Image of Archmage Modera near the City of ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:92432:details:0: I bring ill tidings from ⟦E11⟧. Something has disrupted our ley lines, causing erratic and destructive behavior from our constructs in the city.
rows.quest:92432:details:1: We know not yet what is causing this mayhem. The high council has ordered us to keep this matter private so as to not bring shame to our order. But we cannot keep up this charade forever. The city is being overrun as we speak!
rows.quest:92432:details:2: Archmage Modera has dispatched me to solicit outside aid. Seek her image out near ⟦E11⟧ beside Lordamere Lake.
rows.quest:92434:obj:0: Find a way into ⟦E11⟧ along the Lordamere Lake.
rows.quest:92434:details:0: Whatever caused ⟦E11⟧'s barrier to lower has left the city in turmoil. With you having dealt with their patrols, there is no better time than now to make our way inside and discover their secrets.
rows.quest:92434:details:1: Take the key you found at the internment camp and seek out their sewers along the northern border of the city. With luck, those mages had no reason to put a ward over such a... disagreeable point of entry.
rows.quest:92454:title: Welcome!
rows.quest:92454:obj:0: Bring the Thendal Grove Gift Voucher to Dalia Windbreeze.
rows.quest:92454:details:0: Welcome to the World of Warcraft!
rows.quest:92454:details:1: As special thanks for purchasing the World of Warcraft Collector's Edition, turn in this gift voucher to Dalia Windbreeze in Thendal Grove. You'll then be given a gift: a little companion to join you on your quest for adventure and glory.
rows.quest:92454:details:2: Thanks again, and enjoy your stay in the World of Warcraft!
rows.quest:92454:completion:0: You are indeed a special hero, ⟦3⟧. We welcome you to the world of ⟦E12⟧, and offer you one of these unique gifts!
rows.quest:92456:obj:0: Collect a Fel Infused Blossom from the City of ⟦E11⟧ for Shylamiir in ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:92456:details:0: If you're going to bother me you can at least make yourself useful. I have an errand I need run.
rows.quest:92456:details:1: For a city of mages, ⟦E11⟧ has a surprising interest in botany. The Kirin ⟦E13⟧ keep to themselves, but I would love a sample of their mana-infused vegetation.
rows.quest:92456:details:2: You're clearly someone who is comfortable being where people don't want you, maybe you could find a way into the city. If you do, bring me back whatever is growing in their central garden.
rows.quest:92457:obj:0: Defeat 8 Seeking Remnants, 8 Saturated Remnants, and 8 Mana Echoes inside the City of ⟦E11⟧ for Archmage Modera outside of ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:92457:details:0: The breach has affected many of our factotums and enchantments throughout the city, including many that are seeing to our defenses. This fragmented arcane energy has spoken to rogue elementals who seek to saturate themselves in this free flowing magic.
rows.quest:92457:details:1: While we are busy tending to the wards and other major incidents, it would be a favor to the Kirin ⟦E13⟧ if you could cull this elemental throng.
rows.quest:92458:obj:0: Collect the ⟦E14⟧ Mote for the Image of Archmage Modera near the City of ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:92458:details:0: Whatever disturbed the ley lines, it started at the top of the Violet Citadel. A thunderous crash rang out from the parlors above, and now we are overrun with rampant arcane power. It's taking all we have just to keep the wards in place.
rows.quest:92458:details:1: We cannot afford to stall any longer. We need help.
rows.quest:92458:details:2: The Kirin ⟦E13⟧ are busy inside, but you will still need a less public approach to gain entry. Take this key and meet me in the citadel once you've made your way into the city. We must put an end to this disruption.
rows.quest:92459:obj:0: Speak to Archmage Celindra in the City of ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:92459:details:0: The council will not be happy to learn of our subterfuge, but they cannot deny results. The city is calming down, and we are free to lower our wards.
rows.quest:92459:details:1: I think it's only fair you deliver the good word. Take this mote to Archmage Celindra within the Violet Citadel.
rows.quest:92460:obj:0: Speak with Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:92460:details:0: Look at you, bright eyed and ready for adventure! We've been awaiting your arrival and anticipating your much needed help here in Thendal Village. I imagine you are brimming with both nerves and excitement for what is to come. After all, you only get to come of age once in a lifetime.
rows.quest:92460:details:1: Go, seek out our village leader Rorian the Dayseeker at the entrance to the greatfather tree just west of here. He will get you started on your journey.
rows.quest:92461:obj:0: Slay 8 Vuldren Juveniles in Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:92461:details:0: We live in times of great uncertainty for our people. We face unprecedented challenges that may require bold solutions, but we also must contend with the ordinary and mundane here in Thendal Grove. Take, for example, the recent unsustainable rise in the vuldren population.
rows.quest:92461:details:1: The vuldren are a vital part of our ecosystem. However, imbalances must be corrected to maintain the delicate harmony that all creatures in Thendal Grove share.
rows.quest:92461:details:2: Head east and cull some of the vuldren there.
rows.quest:92462:obj:0: Slay 8 Pesky Cirrusflies in Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:92462:details:0: One of our rangers recently reported an infestation of cirrusflies here in Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:92462:details:1: Cirrusflies can be dangerous if the ⟦E2⟧ is allowed to grow too large, so please head to the eastern end of the Grove and exterminate as many as you can.
rows.quest:92463:obj:0: Destroy the Cirrusfly Queen in Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:92463:details:0: If the forest is as thick with these insects as it sounds, simply killing the workers won't be enough.
rows.quest:92463:details:1: Go deeper into the forest and find the queen. She'll be close to the hive and surrounded by bigger and more aggressive soldiers, so be careful.
rows.quest:92463:details:2: Put her down and return here when it's done. That'll be one less problem to think about around here.
rows.quest:92464:obj:0: Speak to the Yala Windwatcher in Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:92464:details:0: Ever since our elemental benefactors left us, it seems that we are simply moving from one unrest to another. The problem we face now is that the manifestations of the winds near the standing stones to the northeast are agitated.
rows.quest:92464:details:1: Not truly self-aware like the sentient wind spirits that once lived here, these simple sprites respond in kind to forces, emotions, and intentions of the creatures around them.
rows.quest:92464:details:2: My apprentice Yala Windwatcher went to observe them. Seek her out and discover what she's learned.
rows.quest:92465:obj:0: Slay 6 Roiling Winds and 7 Al'Aketh Converts in Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:92465:details:0: The Al'Aketh cult is a blight upon this island. These cultists are surely the ones responsible for agitating the simple wind sprites that reside here and turning them violent.
rows.quest:92465:details:1: Regrettably, we'll need to disperse these roiling winds here before they harm someone. We also need to send a clear message to the cult that they are not welcome in the grove.
rows.quest:92465:details:2: Will you lend me your aid, ?
rows.quest:92469:obj:0: Bring word of the Al'Aketh to Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:92469:details:0: You've done enough here, . I'll stay and clean up any stragglers down there.
rows.quest:92469:details:1: Head back to the Village and tell Rorian about the cult's presence. He will not be pleased.
rows.quest:92470:obj:0: Slay 8 Ursera Scavengers and collect the head of the den mother, Urs'anah in Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:92470:details:0: Rorian informed you that I've been watching you. I now offer you a test of resolve. However, be warned--it will send you into great danger.
rows.quest:92470:details:1: Go to the caves to the south. Thin out the ursera's numbers there, and find their matriarch, one the rangers call "Urs'anah". Put her down and bring me proof of her demise. Once you have done that, you will have taken an important step on your path.
rows.quest:92471:obj:0: Speak with Aetheen of the Gales in Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:92471:details:0: You may not realize this but everything you've done has been a trial of sorts. A test for what is to come for you. It's a big island out there, and Zephras needs spirited young adventurers such as yourself if we are to survive the trials our people face.
rows.quest:92471:details:1: The one called Aetheen of the Gales is one of the leaders of our people here on ⟦E15⟧, and she has been watching you. She has a task that you must complete. Speak with her to learn more.
rows.quest:92472:obj:0: Report to Constable Aonda in Shen'dar Village.
rows.quest:92472:details:0: One of the most pervasive threats on ⟦E15⟧ is the Al'Aketh Cult. They are religious zealots devoted to the worship of the supposed elemental ruler of Skywall, Al'Akir the Windlord. They are brutal, single minded, and their power and ambitions are growing more deadly by the day.
rows.quest:92472:details:1: Your path will soon take you to Shen'dar Village to the south. Present yourself to Constable Aonda when you arrive. The cult threatens Shen'dar and they are in need of aid. Tell Aonda that I sent you.
rows.quest:92473:obj:0: Collect 6 Scrawny Ursera Claws from Scrawny Ursera in Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:92473:details:0: The ursera den to the southwest is rapidly becoming a problem. Just last week the rangers had to kill an adolescent ursera who wandered too close to the village and attempted to attack a boy playing near the base of the elder tree in the center of the village.
rows.quest:92473:details:1: We were fortunate that the boy escaped with his life. Hunger and desperation makes these beasts too dangerous to be left unchecked. Go south and put the scrawniest among the ursera down. Bring me their claws as proof when it is done.
rows.quest:92474:obj:0: Jump from the top of the watchtower in Thendal Grove and use your Walk on Air ability to slow your fall.
rows.quest:92474:details:0: Well hello there, ! Want to play a game?
rows.quest:92474:details:1: All you've got to do is step up on that ledge... then jump! Use your innate ability to walk on the air to slow your fall and see how far forward you can float.
rows.quest:92474:details:2: The rules are made up and the points don't matter, but you get bonus points if you can land right in front of Rorian the Dayseeker and startle him! He won't like it but I'll certainly get a good laugh if you can get him all worked up! Hah!
rows.quest:92481:obj:0: Examine the Glowing Recall Crystal, then speak with Dorii Brightwhisper in Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:92481:details:0: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident mage trainer--Dorii Brightwhisper--left this recall crystal for you. It contains some sort of message for you, so give it a look. Afterwards, you can find Dorii in the structure just behind me.
rows.quest:92482:obj:0: Read the Scribbled Note and then speak with Tai'ree Farsight in Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:92482:details:0: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident hunter trainer--Tai'ree Farsight--left this note for you. You can find her just over yonder near the center of the village. Read the note then seek her out.
rows.quest:92483:obj:0: Read the Simple Note then speak with Akeri Duskblade within the watchtower in Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:92483:details:0: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident rogue trainer--Akeri Duskblade--has requested to speak with you. He left this note, so read that first, then seek him out inside the watchtower, here in the village.
rows.quest:92483:details:1: He's a shady fellow, but then again, so are you. I think you'll get along well.
rows.quest:92484:obj:0: Examine the Humming Recall Crystal then speak with Windshaper Boro in Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:92484:details:0: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident ⟦E17⟧ trainer--Windshaper Boro--left this recall crystal for you. Please examine it, then speak with Boro just over yonder near the center of the village.
rows.quest:92485:obj:0: Read the Folded Parchment then speak with Xyton Silverwind in Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:92485:details:0: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident druid trainer--Xyton Silverwind--left this note for you. Read it as soon as you can, and then seek out Silverwind on the ground floor of this great tree just behind me.
rows.quest:92485:details:1: Heed his words and his counsel, he can teach you much.
rows.quest:92489:obj:0: Slay the Mana Elemental in the City of ⟦E11⟧ for High Sorcerer Andromath in ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:92489:details:0: The Kirin ⟦E13⟧ have long been allies of the ⟦E18⟧. With the destruction of their city at the hands of the arch demon Archimonde, the once proud city of mages has now become reclusive and distrusting of outsiders.
rows.quest:92489:details:1: In recent years they have begun reconstruction efforts to bring the city of ⟦E11⟧ back to its former glory. However, reports show they are struggling to contain an outbreak of wayward arcane energies.
rows.quest:92489:details:2: We must help them disperse these attacks lest we lose one of our most powerful allies.
rows.quest:92532:title: The Warrior's Path
rows.quest:92532:obj:0: Read the Crumpled Note you've been given, then seek out Blademaster Ren inside the Thendal Village watchtower.
rows.quest:92532:details:0: While you were gone our warrior trainer--Blademaster Ren--requested that we send you their way when you returned. She dropped this note off for you as well.
rows.quest:92532:details:1: Give it a read, then find Blademaster Ren inside the village watchtower.
rows.quest:92532:completion:0: You are about to embark upon a dangerous journey. Our world is changing and it will need those who have the will to lead and protect others if our people hope to survive. As you grow in power you will need guidance. Come to me--I will do what I can to train you as you progress.
rows.quest:92532:completion:1: Good luck, ⟦4⟧, may the winds guide you.
rows.quest:92544:title: Al'Aketh Thugs
rows.quest:92544:obj:0: Slay 6 Al'Aketh Brutes, 4 Al'Aketh Neophytes, and Malduko Cloudcrush in Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:92544:details:0: A band of Al'Aketh cult ruffians have taken up residence near the temple ruins just southwest of here, led by a real monster called Malduko Cloudcrush. This rabble has no doubt been dispatched here by High Priestess Lorthuna at the Shrine of Akir to attack travelers and coerce our people into joining the cult.
rows.quest:92544:details:1: I need to stay here at my post to alert travelers leaving the grove of the danger, but I would be grateful if you could do something about those cultists and their leader for me.
rows.quest:92544:completion:0: It was all I could do to stop myself from going over and joining you from my position here. I can only hope that these louts got the message and clear out of here soon.
rows.quest:92544:completion:1: Thank you, ⟦5⟧. You have the gratitude of the Rangers of Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:92597:obj:0: Use your Read Ley Line racial ability at the ley line in Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:92597:obj:1: * Use your Read Ley Line ability near the Thendral Grove Ley Line
rows.quest:92597:details:0: Here in the elemental plane, we derive much of our arcane strength from ley lines that still run through the ground under our feet. Of late, these ley lines have begun to pierce the surface, giving us more direct and powerful access to these latent arcane energies.
rows.quest:92597:details:1: Go to the standing stones to the northeast. There is a ley line there. Tap into your birthright and draw in its energy.
rows.quest:92598:obj:0: Use your Skysight racial ability at the Elemental Convergence in Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:92598:obj:1: * Use your Skysight near the Elemental Convergence
rows.quest:92598:details:0: As a Windshaper, you have the ability to use the sacred skysight gifted to us by the ⟦E19⟧. ⟦E20⟧ to the standing stones to the northeast of the village. Find the elemental convergence there and use your gift.
rows.quest:92598:details:1: You'll find that you may draw upon the skysight anywhere, but its boon is much more powerful if you do so in the presence of an elemental convergence. You may at times receive other bits of wisdom from the spirits that are drawn to such places of power, as well.
rows.quest:92742:obj:0: Use the Well Water Sample Kit to collect samples from the wells at the Jansen Stead and the Molsen Farm.
rows.quest:92742:details:0: We must determine the source and nature of the poison corrupting this land. Let us begin with the groundwater under the farms in the area.
rows.quest:92742:details:1: Go to the Jansen Stead and the Molsen Farm, and collect samples from the wells there.
